categories.main_business_segments: COFCO Technology & Industry Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: professional engineering services and equipment manufacturing. The engineering services include design consulting, electromechanical system delivery, and engineering contracting, covering grain storage, rice milling, flour milling, oil processing, feed processing, biochemical processing, meat processing, and food cold chain sectors. Equipment manufacturing includes milling machines, sieves, drying equipment, oil pressing equipment, storage logistics equipment, steel plate warehouses, and cleaning equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced engineering technologies, including intelligent control systems, digitalization, and green low-carbon technologies. It has developed proprietary equipment such as the MMV intelligent milling machine and cloud-based grain drying systems. The company emphasizes R&D in smart grain storage, dust suppression, low-temperature grain storage, and intelligent cold chain logistics, supported by multiple national and provincial research centers and over 580 active patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large grain and oil processing enterprises, grain storage and logistics companies, cold chain logistics providers, and food processing companies. Representative clients are COFCO Group, Yihai Kerry, Sinograin, port cold chain logistics enterprises like Yantian Port, e-commerce companies such as JD.com, and food processors including COFCO Meat and Shuanghui. The company serves mainly the grain and oil processing industry and the cold chain logistics sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with major offices and subsidiaries located in Wuxi, Zhengzhou, Wuhan, Xi'an, Zhangjiakou, and other cities. Domestic revenue accounts for over 90% of total revenue, with limited international contracts. The company is expanding its international business channels but remains focused on the domestic market.
categories.supply_chain_position: COFCO Technology & Industry operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the grain and oil industry supply chain. It provides engineering design, equipment manufacturing, and system integration services that support grain processing, storage, and logistics. The company acts as a system solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-product distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development, focusing on digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, green low-carbon technologies, and smart grain storage solutions. Key R&D projects include large-scale heat pump grain drying, intelligent dust suppression, smart cold chain logistics platforms, and advanced milling equipment. It aims to enhance technology self-reliance, upgrade traditional industries, and expand into strategic emerging sectors such as bio-based materials and digital creative industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based contracts for engineering services (design consulting, electromechanical system delivery, and engineering contracting) and sales of manufactured equipment. The company secures orders via bidding and direct client commissions for services, and through customer inquiries for equipment sales. Revenue recognition follows progress-based or milestone-based methods depending on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading state-owned enterprise in China's grain and oil engineering services and equipment manufacturing sectors, with strong brand recognition and technical authority. It holds a dominant position supported by its historical legacy, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive service capabilities. Competitors include other specialized engineering firms and equipment manufacturers in the grain, oil, and cold chain logistics industries.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 2.65 billion, a 9.84% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 233.7 million, up 7.34%. The company has shown steady growth with expanding contract volumes, especially in electromechanical system delivery. Total assets reached RMB 4.88 billion, reflecting a 16% increase from the prior year, indicating a solid financial scale and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: COFCO Technology & Industry emphasizes integrated, high-quality engineering solutions combining design, equipment manufacturing, and system delivery tailored to grain, oil, and cold chain logistics industries. Its competitive edge lies in advanced proprietary technologies, extensive R&D capabilities, and a comprehensive product matrix that meets diverse client needs. The company also highlights its commitment to green, intelligent, and digital transformation, providing customers with efficient, sustainable, and innovative solutions.
